The Lean 4 ParseIt library (github.com/fgdorais/lean4-parseit) is the successor of the Lean 4 Parser library (github.com/fgdorais/lean4-parser). The key improvement is that ParseIt is based on iterators instead of streams. The principal consequence of this is that all parser combinators are total! You can now prove the correctness of your parsers. Another interesting consequence is that ParseIt can be up to 50% faster than Parser!

Parser users are encouraged to migrate to ParseIt. There is a migration guide. Parser will continue to get bug fixes and minor updates until the end of June 2027.
